production.note: US model year 2023 only. Motor Authority (Stephen Edelstein, 28 November 2022): "The R8 V10 GT will be sold here as a 2023 model"; "each of the 150 units planned for the U.S., out of 333 globally". Audi of America: "2023 was the final model year for the R8" (audi-usa-r8-coupe; that page itself lists only the V10 performance models). Not to be confused with the 2012 R8 GT (Type 42, 560 hp, quattro), which is a different car and stays held.

body.note: KBB: '2023 Audi R8 GT Coupe 2D'. Coupe only.

configuration.note: Motor Authority: 'R8 V10 GT', 'the German automaker's V-10 engine'; KBB: 'V10, 5.2 Liter'.

displacementL.note: Motor Authority: 'The familiar 5.2-liter'; KBB: 'V10, 5.2 Liter' (kbb-r8-gt-2023). The cc figure was not on a page opened for this car.

aspiration.note: Inferred: the 5.2-litre V10 is described with no turbocharger or supercharger.

fuel.note: Inferred: petrol V10; Motor Authority lists 'a $1,300 gas guzzler tax'.

drivetrain.note: KBB: 'RWD'. Motor Authority: 'the most powerful rear-wheel-drive production car to wear the Audi badge'.

transmission.note: Motor Authority: "The R8's 7-speed dual-clutch automatic also has recalibrated gear ratios" (S tronic). The only transmission.

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL (one named-author article and one database, agreeing; no Audi page for the GT was opened). Quote (Motor Authority, Stephen Edelstein): "The familiar 5.2-liter has been tuned to deliver 602 hp and 413 lb-ft of torque for the U.S. version of the R8 V10 GT." KBB (database): "Horsepower | 602 @ 8700 RPM" (kbb-r8-gt-2023). Car and Driver's photo gallery (republished on Yahoo Autos, unsigned article text, not a spec panel) also says 'the 602-hp state of tune' (cd-yahoo-r8-gt).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (one named-author article and one database, agreeing). Coupe, 7-speed S tronic (the only configuration). Quote (Motor Authority): "bringing the curb weight down to 3,516 pounds"; the same sentence says the US car 'loses 55 pounds compared to the standard R8 V10 RWD coupe' (Audi of America lists that car at 3,571 lb). KBB (database): "Curb Weight | 3516 lbs." (kbb-r8-gt-2023). Automoblog (unsigned 'Automoblog Staff', not counted) also gives 3,516 lb. A news story attributed to Car and Driver (AOL copy, unsigned; the publication is not named on the AOL page) says: "The GT will weigh 44 pounds less than the R8 Coupe Performance RWD." (aol-cd-r8-gt), i.e. about 3,527 lb (3,571 - 44), under 1% from 3,516 lb.

Audi of America's R8 GT release or specification page, or a major magazine specification panel for the 2023 R8 GT, would replace both.
